name: Tokimeki Factory ~Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side~
original_name: ときめきファクトリー～ときめきメモリアルGirl's Side～
source:
A game that allows you to create your own stories using the characters from [url=/v857]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side[/url]. The boy's clothing, background, music, and more are all original, and there are over 1,000 voiced lines for each character. 

What kind of adventures will you have with the boy you admire?

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkfc/contents/index.html]official website[/url]]

Some of the content and stories made by the community is available on the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkfc/community/index.html]official website[/url].
translation:
一款让你使用《心跳回忆Girl's Side》角色创作自己故事的游戏。男主角的服装、背景、音乐等均为原创，每个角色都有超过1000句配音台词。

你将和心仪的男孩经历怎样的冒险呢？

[译自并改编自[url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkfc/contents/index.html]官方网站[/url]]

社区创作的部分内容和故事可在[url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkfc/community/index.html]官方网站[/url]查看。
